text: Have you ever noticed that girls who hate men always have the best boyfriends? Like, how do we get here? You'll hear her say, I don't trust none of y'all. And then boom, she's posting a man who treats her like a queen. How do these ladies even come up with ideas like that? Today's special one, women who hate men end up with the best ones. This is absurd. Women who hate men, by definition, can't end up with the best men. They end up with convenient men, the spineless ones, the yes-queen types with no backbone, no boundaries, and no self-respect. The kind of guys who exist to please, not to have own opinion. Because real men, the ones who've built themselves, who have standards, confidence, and options, don't go for women who treat men like enemies. They choose women who bring peace, not conflict, respect, not resentment. Saying that women who hate men end up with the best men is like saying that people who hate dogs end up working at animal shelters. It is nonsense. People don't choose what they despise. And men who value themselves don't choose women who despise them. So no, the women who don't need men and don't trust men aren't getting the best men. They're getting the ones who don't have enough self-respect to walk away.
